title: Plugin
description: What a plugin declares about itself in its plugin.json. The cockpit is the surface; plugins bring the mechanisms — a reader for the card and the working view, optional actions, optionally a whole web application mounted under /m/<id>/app. A customer's own tool is attached the same way: a manifest, a reader, and the sources it needs released in cockpit.toml. A plugin runs inside the cockpit's process with the cockpit's rights: the access layer governs readers that go through it, it cannot stop code that does not. Install plugins you have read.

reader.description: Dotted module providing read(), and optionally detail() and document().

app.description: A web application the plugin brings, mounted inside the cockpit.

factory.description: package.module:function taking a config path and returning an ASGI app.

path.description: Where the package lives, relative to the manifest.

config.description: Default config file for the factory.

mounts_under_prefix.description: true when the app builds its links from request.scope['root_path'] — the one requirement for mounting.

needs.description: Source ids the reader expects, in the order the module's `sources` should list them.

actions.description: Action ids the plugin's tool supports; the cockpit config maps forms onto them.

locales.description: Directory of <lang>.json files merged into the cockpit's, relative to the manifest.
